DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: Isn't there a Dr Fenkenstrain on the mainland?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: Isn't there a Dr Fenkenstrain on the mainland?

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: I'd like to ask you first...
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: I'd like to ask you first...

Message.SourceString: Shockingly, you are able to capture the lightning in a bottle. You allow yourself to indulge in a single electricity based pun, and note that you should return to Doctor Fenkenstrain sooner rather than later.
Message.LocalizedString: Shockingly, you are able to capture the lightning in a bottle. You allow yourself to indulge in a single electricity based pun, and note that you should return to Doctor Fenkenstrain sooner rather than later.

Message.SourceString: There has been... a miscalculation.
Message.LocalizedString: There has been... a miscalculation.

Message.SourceString: Some of the muscles have deteriorated a little, as if the previous owner wasn't a focused fighter. Unusual for a garou.
Message.LocalizedString: Some of the muscles have deteriorated a little, as if the previous owner wasn't a focused fighter. Unusual for a garou.

Message.SourceString: WITH SCIENCE!
Message.LocalizedString: WITH SCIENCE!

Message.SourceString: Some simple potions will suffice. You'll need a weak antipoison for the veins, a weak lumberjack potion for the muscles and a weak focused attack potion for the superficial damage.
Message.LocalizedString: Some simple potions will suffice. You'll need a weak antipoison for the veins, a weak lumberjack potion for the muscles and a weak focused attack potion for the superficial damage.

Message.SourceString: If you can bring me these, then we can continue with our research and shatter the languid assumptions of layman SCIENCE!
Message.LocalizedString: If you can bring me these, then we can continue with our research and shatter the languid assumptions of layman SCIENCE!

Message.SourceString: Interesting. Poison damage, a lack of arm strength and some superficial damage to the legs indicating poor survival skills. All of these are problems that can be easily resolved...
Message.LocalizedString: Interesting. Poison damage, a lack of arm strength and some superficial damage to the legs indicating poor survival skills. All of these are problems that can be easily resolved...

Message.SourceString: WITH SCIENCE!
Message.LocalizedString: WITH SCIENCE!

Message.SourceString: Some simple potions will suffice. You'll need a weak antipoison for the veins, a weak lumberjack potion for the muscles and a weak focused attack potion for the superficial damage.
Message.LocalizedString: Some simple potions will suffice. You'll need a weak antipoison for the veins, a weak lumberjack potion for the muscles and a weak focused attack potion for the superficial damage.

Message.SourceString: If you can bring me these, then we can continue with our research and shatter the languid assumptions of layman SCIENCE!
Message.LocalizedString: If you can bring me these, then we can continue with our research and shatter the languid assumptions of layman SCIENCE!

Message.SourceString: You administer the potions. The veins clear up and the muscles look stronger. The cuts and bruises vanish before your eyes, but nothing else seems to happ...
Message.LocalizedString: You administer the potions. The veins clear up and the muscles look stronger. The cuts and bruises vanish before your eyes, but nothing else seems to happ...

Message.SourceString: Fool! Without those potions, the body cannot function. Science will be wasted and you will singlehandedly ruin one of the greatest scientific breakthroughs ever known! Come back when you've changed your mind and are ready to rewrite the rules of reality!
Message.LocalizedString: Fool! Without those potions, the body cannot function. Science will be wasted and you will singlehandedly ruin one of the greatest scientific breakthroughs ever known! Come back when you've changed your mind and are ready to rewrite the rules of reality!

Message.SourceString: A sturdy pair of well-preserved garou arms. Perfect for sinister science experiments.
Message.LocalizedString: A sturdy pair of well-preserved garou arms. Perfect for sinister science experiments.

Message.SourceString: There! It moved! A twitch, subtle and slight, but definite movement.
Message.LocalizedString: There! It moved! A twitch, subtle and slight, but definite movement.

Message.SourceString: Not enough though, hrmm... AHA! I know what we need!
Message.LocalizedString: Not enough though, hrmm... AHA! I know what we need!

Message.SourceString: Lightning!
Message.LocalizedString: Lightning!

Message.SourceString: Here, take this! It may look like an ordinary bottle, but this has been carefully en-scienced to contain pure lightning -- don't ask about how it works, your tiny mind would buckle under the weight of such knowledge.
Message.LocalizedString: Here, take this! It may look like an ordinary bottle, but this has been carefully en-scienced to contain pure lightning -- don't ask about how it works, your tiny mind would buckle under the weight of such knowledge.

Message.SourceString: Now, all you need to do, is get struck by lightning whilst holding this. You'll be fine, don't grumble. Get shocked, then bring it back here and we shall continue our experiment!
Message.LocalizedString: Now, all you need to do, is get struck by lightning whilst holding this. You'll be fine, don't grumble. Get shocked, then bring it back here and we shall continue our experiment!

Message.SourceString: Oh.You appear to be overloaded from your own scientific experiments. It's easy to get carried away. Return to me when you have some space free.
Message.LocalizedString: Oh.You appear to be overloaded from your own scientific experiments. It's easy to get carried away. Return to me when you have some space free.

Message.SourceString: Graverobbing is a terrible hobby best left to necromancers and mad scientists.
Message.LocalizedString: Graverobbing is a terrible hobby best left to necromancers and mad scientists.

Message.SourceString: Graverobbing is a terrible hobby best left to necromancers and mad scientists.
Message.LocalizedString: Graverobbing is a terrible hobby best left to necromancers and mad scientists.

Message.SourceString: Now we move into the final phase! Igor... err, I mean... what's your name again? Doesn't matter, attach my head to my new body! We shall make SCIENTIFIC HISTORY!
Message.LocalizedString: Now we move into the final phase! Igor... err, I mean... what's your name again? Doesn't matter, attach my head to my new body! We shall make SCIENTIFIC HISTORY!

Message.SourceString: You attach the head to the body as best you can, it's much looser than you're comfortable with.
Message.LocalizedString: You attach the head to the body as best you can, it's much looser than you're comfortable with.

Message.SourceString: A perfect fit!
Message.LocalizedString: A perfect fit!

Message.SourceString: All that we need now, is that spark of the divine power of creation - lightning! Add the bottled lightning to the pylon, so I may stride this world again as the genius to end all geniuses...geniei?...SCIENTISTS!
Message.LocalizedString: All that we need now, is that spark of the divine power of creation - lightning! Add the bottled lightning to the pylon, so I may stride this world again as the genius to end all geniuses...geniei?...SCIENTISTS!

Message.SourceString: It is not a perfect fit.
Message.LocalizedString: It is not a perfect fit.

Message.SourceString: I shall live again! You have served me well Not-Igor, I shall be sure to add your name to my research paper as a noted contributor. On the last page of course.
Message.LocalizedString: I shall live again! You have served me well Not-Igor, I shall be sure to add your name to my research paper as a noted contributor. On the last page of course.

Message.SourceString: You uncover a surprisingly well preserved pair of goblin legs. The toes are still twitching.
Message.LocalizedString: You uncover a surprisingly well preserved pair of goblin legs. The toes are still twitching.

Message.SourceString: I don't really care. I only asked out of habit. Still, now that you're here, perhaps you can do something for me?
Message.LocalizedString: I don't really care. I only asked out of habit. Still, now that you're here, perhaps you can do something for me?

Message.SourceString: I don't really care. I only asked out of habit. Still, now that you're here, perhaps you can do something for me?
Message.LocalizedString: I don't really care. I only asked out of habit. Still, now that you're here, perhaps you can do something for me?

Message.SourceString: Bwahahahahahahahahaha...ahem... oh... hello. Who might you be then?
Message.LocalizedString: Bwahahahahahahahahaha...ahem... oh... hello. Who might you be then?

Message.SourceString: I don't really care. I only asked out of habit. Still, now that you're here, perhaps you can do something for me?
Message.LocalizedString: I don't really care. I only asked out of habit. Still, now that you're here, perhaps you can do something for me?

Message.SourceString: An unusual collection of body parts. I don't suppose you could have found something in a size nine?
Message.LocalizedString: An unusual collection of body parts. I don't suppose you could have found something in a size nine?

Message.SourceString: You connect the body parts together like some terrible jigsaw puzzle. Your mother would be so proud.
Message.LocalizedString: You connect the body parts together like some terrible jigsaw puzzle. Your mother would be so proud.

Message.SourceString: Ah, you have it! Not going to lie, there was a good chance that wasn't going to work and you'd be obliterated. Fortunately, that is not the case!
Message.LocalizedString: Ah, you have it! Not going to lie, there was a good chance that wasn't going to work and you'd be obliterated. Fortunately, that is not the case!

Message.SourceString: What would you like to examine?
Message.LocalizedString: What would you like to examine?

Message.SourceString: A pair of powerful garou arms. They are fresher than you like to admit, perhaps only a few days old.
Message.LocalizedString: A pair of powerful garou arms. They are fresher than you like to admit, perhaps only a few days old.

Message.SourceString: Goblin legs, in a surprisingly good state. Goblin legs may look bandy and spindly, but they're surprisingly strong and would make a good foundation for this... creation.
Message.LocalizedString: Goblin legs, in a surprisingly good state. Goblin legs may look bandy and spindly, but they're surprisingly strong and would make a good foundation for this... creation.

Message.SourceString: Interesting. Poison damage, a lack of arm strength and some superficial damage to the legs indicating poor survival skills. All of these are problems that can be easily resolved...
Message.LocalizedString: Interesting. Poison damage, a lack of arm strength and some superficial damage to the legs indicating poor survival skills. All of these are problems that can be easily resolved...

Message.SourceString: Ah good, you've brought the potions. Wonderful! Now if you would just use them on the Examination Table.
Message.LocalizedString: Ah good, you've brought the potions. Wonderful! Now if you would just use them on the Examination Table.

Message.SourceString: Oh.You appear to be overloaded from your own scientific experiments. It's easy to get carried away. Return to me when you have some space free.
Message.LocalizedString: Oh.You appear to be overloaded from your own scientific experiments. It's easy to get carried away. Return to me when you have some space free.

Message.SourceString: Best leave this alone for the moment.
Message.LocalizedString: Best leave this alone for the moment.

Message.SourceString: They called me mad. MAD! Me, the greatest genius of the age! But I'll show them! I'll show them all!
Message.LocalizedString: They called me mad. MAD! Me, the greatest genius of the age! But I'll show them! I'll show them all!

Message.SourceString: The torso is muscular and well-preserved, perhaps the remains of a skilled warrior.
Message.LocalizedString: The torso is muscular and well-preserved, perhaps the remains of a skilled warrior.

Message.SourceString: A strange pylon, looks like there's a slot for something.
Message.LocalizedString: A strange pylon, looks like there's a slot for something.

Message.SourceString: You install the lightning into the pylon, it hums with power.
Message.LocalizedString: You install the lightning into the pylon, it hums with power.

Message.SourceString: A medical table, with straps to keep a body in place. You choose not to dwell on why someone might just have this lying around.
Message.LocalizedString: A medical table, with straps to keep a body in place. You choose not to dwell on why someone might just have this lying around.

Message.SourceString: Excellent. EXCELLENT! Do you feel it? The power? That hum of possibility as we prepare to destroy death itself! BWAHAHAHAHAA MAD THEY CALLED ME! MAD!
Message.LocalizedString: Excellent. EXCELLENT! Do you feel it? The power? That hum of possibility as we prepare to destroy death itself! BWAHAHAHAHAA MAD THEY CALLED ME! MAD!

Message.SourceString: I need you to collect a few things. Nothing too strenuous, just some arms, legs, that sort of stuff. You can easily dig them up from graves around the Bloodblight Swamps, hardly an inconvenience really. Well? Science waits for no one! Go! GET!
Message.LocalizedString: I need you to collect a few things. Nothing too strenuous, just some arms, legs, that sort of stuff. You can easily dig them up from graves around the Bloodblight Swamps, hardly an inconvenience really. Well? Science waits for no one! Go! GET!

Message.SourceString: Now, all you need to do, is get struck by lightning whilst holding that bottle I gave you. You'll be fine, don't grumble. Get shocked, then bring it back here and we shall continue our experiment!
Message.LocalizedString: Now, all you need to do, is get struck by lightning whilst holding that bottle I gave you. You'll be fine, don't grumble. Get shocked, then bring it back here and we shall continue our experiment!

Message.SourceString: Oh.You appear to be overloaded from your own scientific experiments. It's easy to get carried away. Return to me when you have some space free.
Message.LocalizedString: Oh.You appear to be overloaded from your own scientific experiments. It's easy to get carried away. Return to me when you have some space free.

Message.SourceString: You need lightning-in-a-bottle to power this machine.
Message.LocalizedString: You need lightning-in-a-bottle to power this machine.

Message.SourceString: Now now, don't be squeamish, go give that body a poke would you? See what needs fixing with it.
Message.LocalizedString: Now now, don't be squeamish, go give that body a poke would you? See what needs fixing with it.

Message.SourceString: I need you to collect a few things. Nothing too strenuous, just some arms, legs, that sort of stuff. You can easily dig them up around the Bloodblight Swamps, hardly an inconvenience really.
Message.LocalizedString: I need you to collect a few things. Nothing too strenuous, just some arms, legs, that sort of stuff. You can easily dig them up around the Bloodblight Swamps, hardly an inconvenience really.

Message.SourceString: Look around big scary trees, that's where people normally seem to want to bury their dead around here.
Message.LocalizedString: Look around big scary trees, that's where people normally seem to want to bury their dead around here.

Message.SourceString: Graverobbing is a terrible hobby best left to necromancers and mad scientists.
Message.LocalizedString: Graverobbing is a terrible hobby best left to necromancers and mad scientists.

Message.SourceString: Some might call what we're doing ghoulish, but I prefer the term recycling. Reduce, reuse, recycle for a better future and all that.
Message.LocalizedString: Some might call what we're doing ghoulish, but I prefer the term recycling. Reduce, reuse, recycle for a better future and all that.

Message.SourceString: Excellent. Excellent! A somewhat motley collection of components, but we can work with it.
Message.LocalizedString: Excellent. Excellent! A somewhat motley collection of components, but we can work with it.

Message.SourceString: Bwahahahahaha! Oh, hrmm? What do you want?
Message.LocalizedString: Bwahahahahaha! Oh, hrmm? What do you want?

Message.SourceString: Me? I was once-- no, I still am-- the most ingenius inventor of this and all other ages!
Message.LocalizedString: Me? I was once-- no, I still am-- the most ingenius inventor of this and all other ages!

Message.SourceString: That is a very personal question, and we are not yet well acquainted enough for you to learn the answer.
Message.LocalizedString: That is a very personal question, and we are not yet well acquainted enough for you to learn the answer.

Message.SourceString: Ah, the bloodline persists does it? But of course it must, great great grandmummy was ever so popular around the town.
Message.LocalizedString: Ah, the bloodline persists does it? But of course it must, great great grandmummy was ever so popular around the town.

Message.SourceString: Doctor Victor Fenkenstrain!
Message.LocalizedString: Doctor Victor Fenkenstrain!

Message.SourceString: In my youth I offered solutions to the problems of Ashenfall with my wonderous inventions. They spurned my genius, then, all because of a few fires and a handful of bloody dismemberments.
Message.LocalizedString: In my youth I offered solutions to the problems of Ashenfall with my wonderous inventions. They spurned my genius, then, all because of a few fires and a handful of bloody dismemberments.

Message.SourceString: Tragedies, yes, but tragedies that opened my eyes to my true destiny and the research that would consume my every waking moment..
Message.LocalizedString: Tragedies, yes, but tragedies that opened my eyes to my true destiny and the research that would consume my every waking moment..

Message.SourceString: Death? HA! A minor inconvenience! One I sought to overcome and overcome it I did! All it took was lightning, various chemicals and being shunned by everyone around me!
Message.LocalizedString: Death? HA! A minor inconvenience! One I sought to overcome and overcome it I did! All it took was lightning, various chemicals and being shunned by everyone around me!

Message.SourceString: A human torso! Just what you've always wanted.
Message.LocalizedString: A human torso! Just what you've always wanted.

Message.SourceString: Yet here I am, and here they aren't! I was right! I win! I am the greatest genius in Ashenfall! AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
Message.LocalizedString: Yet here I am, and here they aren't! I was right! I win! I am the greatest genius in Ashenfall! AHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!

Message.SourceString: Just know that when I find that accursed chicken again, it shall rue the day. RUE THE VERY DAY!
Message.LocalizedString: Just know that when I find that accursed chicken again, it shall rue the day. RUE THE VERY DAY!

Message.SourceString: She made all her husbands carry her surname, don't you know.
Message.LocalizedString: She made all her husbands carry her surname, don't you know.

Message.SourceString: Tragically they all died of natural causes... entirely natural, indeed.
Message.LocalizedString: Tragically they all died of natural causes... entirely natural, indeed.

Message.SourceString: Still, no matter, science demands sacrifice and the parts are at least fresh enough to work with... surprisingly well preserved in some cases...
Message.LocalizedString: Still, no matter, science demands sacrifice and the parts are at least fresh enough to work with... surprisingly well preserved in some cases...

Message.SourceString: Best not to dwell, I'm sure there's a lorebook somewhere to explain the lack of decay or something. There's always an excuse.
Message.LocalizedString: Best not to dwell, I'm sure there's a lorebook somewhere to explain the lack of decay or something. There's always an excuse.

Message.SourceString: Now, stick the parts on the examination table will you? Then we can really have some fun.
Message.LocalizedString: Now, stick the parts on the examination table will you? Then we can really have some fun.

Message.SourceString: Now, take a look at each of the components, let's make sure they're in good nick. Can't be working with substandard tools, now can we!
Message.LocalizedString: Now, take a look at each of the components, let's make sure they're in good nick. Can't be working with substandard tools, now can we!

Message.SourceString: Thin greenish veins run through the torso that generate an acrid smell. The signs of some sort of toxic corruption of the flesh.
Message.LocalizedString: Thin greenish veins run through the torso that generate an acrid smell. The signs of some sort of toxic corruption of the flesh.

Message.SourceString: There are some small cuts and bruises across the legs, indication of some minor damaged sustained before the significantly more major damage that allowed you to find these legs in the first place.
Message.LocalizedString: There are some small cuts and bruises across the legs, indication of some minor damaged sustained before the significantly more major damage that allowed you to find these legs in the first place.
